title: Bounded-Ratio Multinomial Experiment Transfer and Minimax Limits along Common Recession Rays
banked_reason: D0.5 general referee: meets_floor=false, tier=incremental, paper_score_ceiling 5.4 < field gate 7.4, salvageable=false; effective compatible density and the four-label milliscale certificate remain unresolved.
gap_reasons: The unconditional results establish atomic dual exhaustion, local smoothing and averaging inequalities, compact Carter transfer, coordinatewise causal endpoint attainment, and windowed minimax convergence, but they do not establish the advertised quantitative recession-gluing construction.

Effective compatible density is left open, so CertGluePFL termination, replayable moving-offset Gaussian rules, and global certified upper bounds remain conditional; only a global liminf and a window-restricted two-sided limit are proved.
The four-label test still has the very wide certified interval [0.361100, 0.813799], so the proposed certification method lacks even its stated bounded-instance validation.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery attempted to derive a simultaneous, effective recession-incidence gluing theorem and use it to obtain a terminating CertGluePFL primal-dual certificate and global multinomial transfer. Review preserved common-ray coherence, compact Carter comparison, a global minimax lower limit, and two-sided convergence on diagonal expanding windows, but the five effective-compatible-density obligations and the promised four-label milliscale certificate remained open. A correctable sign error also remains in equations (7)-(8) of the atomic-duality derivation, and the Carter/BFFL source attestations were not accepted by the pipeline before termination.
tldr: The unconditional contribution consists of three proved pieces: common-ray Foelner operators are path-independent and have explicit translation-boundary ratios; Carter's bounded-ratio kernels give fixed-base compact multinomial transfer with separately displayed semantic, covariance, and \(C_{2/\kappa}m\log(m)/\sqrt n\) charges; and compact exhaustion gives a global minimax lower limit together with two-sided convergence on diagonally selected expanding lawful windows, but no global upper limit. Replayable moving-offset transfer and CertGluePFL termination remain conditional on a separately supplied finite compatibility package satisfying the five certificates listed in the open-ended question.
gap: Existing geometry makes recession incidences compatible, existing numerical analysis encloses individual Gaussian-polytope integrals, and existing decision theory treats compact parameter classes. Existing Job Corps work includes average and multiple-quantile wage-effect bounds for always-employed survivors under assignment and average bounds for always-employed compliers under noncompliance. The missing theorem is a simultaneous rule-level approximation over the entire unbounded incidence diagram with one computable weighted modulus, followed by a complete primal-dual stopping recurrence and moving-face multinomial transfer for coordinatewise sharp always-selected-complier quantile-effect labels.
fill: Nested covariance-orthogonal averaging, the explicit homogeneous recession refinement, semantic projection, weighted path accounting, repair, and atomic dual enumeration form the generic certificate program. The causal bridge uses the full complier-restricted latent fiber and a globally completed tangent fan built from active cuts at \(p_0\). The moving-offset system and four-label benchmark now have explicit finite constructions and receipts.
